content: Tuki hetsiemieme kememɨte'ikuxeɨri 'imikieri

Rawiri ti'aitame memɨyuxeɨriekai mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Kakaɨyari neniwe Tsarumuni kananayexeiya, peru mɨkɨ 'akuxi pɨkarakumate 'uximayatsika pɨmariwe. 'Ikɨ tuki 'amɨpa tewi pɨkatipiinieya, matsi Kakaɨyari Yawé pɨta katinipiinieyatɨni.

Waɨkawamekɨ neyuwaɨriyatɨ nekatiniukuha'arita Kakaɨyari tukieya hetsiemieme. Piinite tukita timieme mɨtitiwewiyanikɨ nekatiniuxeɨrieni, huru, pɨrata, wurunitse, tepɨa, kɨyexi, meta waɨkawa 'unitse teteyari, tetexi 'ixurikitsie mɨkayatsarɨwa, tetexi mɨherɨkarietɨka witsimutiyɨtɨka, tetexi witsimɨ'anene yutsata meta waɨkawame marimuri teteyari.
Ketipaɨmeme nemɨtiukuxeɨriekai mɨkɨ nekati'inɨatatɨ, nekakaɨyari tukieya nenaki'erietɨ nepiyetuani tuki hetsiemieme naime huru meta pɨrata nemeixeiya:

xeitsienituyari miriyari kiruyari pɨrahetekai huru 'Upixi mieme, meta huta tsienituyari heimana xeitewiyari heimana tamamata miriyari kiruyari raheteme pɨrata 'aixɨa mɨ'ane, mɨkɨkɨ tuki muwakuwiriyarienikɨ,
piinite hurukɨ mɨtitiwewierekɨ meta pɨratakɨ, metatsiere tsepa tita memɨte'utiwewi tepɨakɨ te'uximayatamete. ¿Kemɨ'aneta hikɨ xeme 'imikieri pɨyetuani Yawé hetsiemieme?»

Hikɨ 'ukirawetsixi yutɨɨriyama memɨwareuxeiya, 'Ixaheri nuiwarimama memɨwanɨ'a, xeimiriyari kuyaxi memɨwanɨ'a meta xeitsienituyari kuyaxi memɨwanɨ'a metatsiere ti'aitame 'uximayatsikaya memɨhɨritɨariekai, mɨkɨ 'imikieri mekaniyetuani kememɨteheuyɨwawekai.

Mɨkɨ mekaniyetuani Kakaɨyari tukieya hetsiemieme mɨtitiwewiyanikɨ, xeitsienituyari heimana haika tewiyari heimana 'auxɨwi miriyari (165.000) kiruyari raheteme meta tamamata miriyari huru tuminiyari, haika tsienituyari heimana xeitewiyari heimana tamamata (330.000) kiruyari raheteme huru, 'ataxewi tsienituyari miriyari kiruyari raheteme wurunitse tepɨayari, meta haika miyuniyari heimana haika tsienituyari kiruyari raheteme tepɨa.
Kemɨ'ane tetexi memeixeiyakai witsimɨ'anene mekaniyetɨani Kehieri hetsɨa, mɨkɨ Keritsuni nuiwarieya pɨhɨkɨtɨkai, mekaniyetuani Yawé tukieyata mieme mɨrayanikɨ.
Hikɨ yunaitɨ kiekatari waɨkawa mekaniyutemamawiekaitɨni memɨyɨwawekaikɨ memiyetuani 'imikieri Yawé hetsiemieme, yaxeikɨa ti'aitame Rawiri waɨkawa kaniyutemawiekaitɨni.
Rawiri kemɨtiuyutanenewi
Merikɨte Rawiri Yawé 'aixɨa katiniutahɨawe yunaime teɨteri wahɨxie, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ:

content.text: meta 'ekɨ pepɨhɨkɨ mariweme pemɨrayeitɨani meta yunaime pemuwatɨrɨkariya.

content: »Peru, ne tixaɨtɨ nepɨkatihɨkɨ meta neteɨterima tixaɨtɨ mepɨkatehɨkɨ, tita meta 'imikieri temateyetuiri tixaɨtɨ pɨkatihɨkɨ. Yurikɨtsɨ 'ekɨ, tinaitɨ 'apiini katinihɨkɨtɨni, tame ketita temateyetuiri, mɨkɨ katinihɨkɨtɨni 'ekɨ pemɨtatiyetuiri.
'Ahɨxie tame, ku'uwamete tekanihɨkɨtɨni meta kɨkamete, ta'ukiyarima memɨ'anekai hepaɨ meripaitɨ. Tatukari 'ena kwiepa 'etɨri hepaɨ kani'aneni mɨkareutetere.
Yawé takakaɨyari, 'ikɨ naitɨ ketita temɨte'ukuxeɨri tuki temɨtawewienikɨ 'ahetsiemieme, 'ekɨ pepɨtatiupitɨa. Naitɨ pɨti'apiini.

Nekakaɨyari 'aku, ne nepɨtimate 'ekɨ 'iyarite pepɨxeiya kemɨtiku'eriwa meta pepinaki'erie tita mɨtiheitserie. 'Ayumieme ne'iyari heitseriekaku nematiyetuiri 'ikɨ naime piinite, meta nepɨwaruxei 'ateɨterima meyutemamawietɨ kememɨte'iyetua yumawari kememɨteyuwaɨriya.
Yawé, ta'ukiyarima wakakaɨyari 'Apɨrahami, 'Itsahaki meta 'Ixaheri, hikɨ hepaɨ meteyɨkɨhɨaweme keniwapitɨaka wa'iyaritsie yuheyemekɨ, mɨkɨ yu'iyaritsie memɨmatsiha'eriwanikɨ keniwapitɨaka.

Yaxeikɨata neniwe Tsarumuni keneupitɨa 'iyari 'aixɨa tiyɨkɨhɨaweme, yamɨtikamienikɨ meta yamɨtiyurienenikɨ 'a'aitsikatsie meta 'a'inɨari niukiyari naimetsie. Keneupitɨa tuki mɨtawewienikɨ hetsiena timieme nemɨtiukuha'aritaxɨ».

Hikɨ Rawiri yunaime teɨteri mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Yawé xekenenɨawani yukakaɨyari». Hikɨ yunaitɨ teɨteri Yawé mekaniutanɨawa, yu'ukiyarima wakakaɨyari, meta Yawé hɨxie mekaniukahɨxima'uni metatsiere ti'aitame hɨxie.
Tsarumuni ti'aitame kemɨratɨa

Hikɨ 'uxa'arieka, Yawé mekaniyetuirieni waɨkawa mawari meta mawari taiyariyari, yunaime 'ixaheritsixi wahetsiemieme: xeimiriyari turutsixi temari, xeimiriyari muxatsi 'ukitsi meta xeimiriyari muxatsi 'etsimemɨpepe, winu mawariyari heutinɨtɨkaime, meta waɨkawa hipame mawari.

Mɨkɨ tukaritsie mepɨte'ukwai meta mepɨte'anu'i meyutemamawietɨ Yawé hɨxie. Hikɨ 'ana hutarieka teɨteri Tsarumuni ti'aitame mayanikɨ yamekaniutiyuani Rawiri nu'aya, Yawé hɨxie hatseiti mu'uyatsie mekanikawirieni ti'aitame mayanikɨ, meta Tsaruki mekaniukawirieni mawari wewiwame mayanikɨ.
Hikɨ Tsarumuni Yawé 'uwenieya hetsie kanayerɨni yu'ukiyari hetsiemieme Rawiri, hikɨ ti'aitakaku naitɨ 'aixɨa katiniuyɨni. Yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi yamekatenikahukaitɨni kemainekai.
Yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi wa'ukiyarima, kuyaxi waɨkawa memɨyɨwawe meta ti'aitame Rawiri niwemama yamekaniutiyuani 'aixɨa 'anemekɨ memiparewienikɨ ti'aitame Tsarumuni.
Yawé mariweme kanayeitɨani Tsarumuni naitsarie 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie, meta kanipitɨani mɨti'aitanikɨ mariwemekɨ mariwatɨ, nixewitɨ mɨkareixeiyakai hepaɨ te'aitamete 'Ixaheritsie memanuka'ui.
Rawiri kemɨtiumɨ
Rawiri 'Itsahi nu'aya katiniuta'aita naitsarie 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie.

Naimekɨ, pɨtiuta'aitaxɨ huta tewiyari wiyari 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie: Hewuruni pukatei ti'aitatɨ 'atahuta wiyari, meta Kerutsareme 'ukaitɨ pɨtiuta'aitaxɨ xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana haika wiyari.
Hikɨ kaniumɨni waɨkawa 'ukiratsitɨtɨri, 'aixɨa raniuwakaku hetsiena mieme meta waɨkawa xikutɨtɨ, nu'aya Tsarumuni hetsiena mieme katiniuta'aita.

Naime Rawiri kemɨtiuyuri, mɨtiutsutɨatsie meta 'imatɨrieka kemɨtiuyuri, kemɨtiuta'aitaxɨ kemɨtitɨrɨkaɨyekai, meta kemɨtiyuri, 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie kemɨtiuyɨ meta kiekari 'auriena mamanetɨkatsie, naitɨ katinaka'utɨarieni kemɨtiuyɨ xapayaritetsie mɨtaniere Tsamuheri meka'utɨatsie, Kakaɨyari niukameya Natani meka'utɨatsie meta mɨtaniere Kahari meka'utɨatsie.
